g.text: A Eight requests: client spans and the selected first-prefill / first-decode windows
8 requests x 1024 output tokens; both ranks carry 4 requests. Uncolored client time is outside this selected process scope.
Cross-device fine-grained concurrency has no promoted clock-error bound; these intervals do not quantify accelerator utilization.
